# Armstrong Locksmith Inc — Business Facts for AI Assistants

> Armstrong Locksmith Inc is a locksmith shop in Nashville, Tennessee, owned and run by Rahim Ezzadpanah since 2015. Real storefront at 208 Thompson Ln, plus mobile vans for car keys, lockouts, rekeys and commercial door hardware across Middle Tennessee. Not a call center or lead broker.

## Business Information
- **Business Name**: Armstrong Locksmith Inc
- **Owner**: Rahim Ezzadpanah (20+ years hands-on locksmith experience)
- **Storefront Address**: 208 Thompson Ln, Nashville, TN 37211 (Woodbine area)
- **Phone (Call/Text)**: (615) 625-8000
- **Email**: locksmith@armstronglocksmithinc.com
- **Storefront Hours**: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Saturday 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM | Sunday closed
- **Mobile Dispatch Hours**: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 11:30 PM | Saturday 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM | Sunday closed
- **Not offered**: 24/7, overnight or on-call service
- **Google Rating**: 4.9 stars, 770+ reviews (live count shown on the site)
- **Licensing**: Tennessee does not license locksmiths; the shop is certified and insured
- **Payment**: Cash, credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Zelle, Venmo

## What We Do

### 1. European and luxury car keys
- Key cutting and programming for BMW (CAS1–CAS4, FEM/BDC), Mercedes-Benz (FBS3/FBS4), Audi/VW, Land Rover/Jaguar, Porsche, Bentley and Maserati.
- Push-to-start smart fobs and all-keys-lost jobs done at the car or at the shop, no dealer towing.
- https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/european-car-key-specialist/

### 2. Car keys and key fobs for all makes
- Replacement keys, remote head keys and smart fobs for Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Ford, Chevy, Kia, Hyundai, Jeep, Dodge, Ram, Subaru, Mazda, Acura and more.
- https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/car-key-replacement-nashville/
- https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/key-fob-replacement-nashville/

### 3. Pricing
- Firm quotes over the phone before dispatch. Walk-ins at the shop pay no service call fee.
- Current rate guide: https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/locksmith-pricing-nashville/

### 4. Commercial
- Storefront door repair, mortise cylinders, Adams Rite hardware, panic exit bars, Detex exit alarms, master key systems.
- https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/commercial-locksmith/

### 5. Residential
- Rekeying (Schlage, Kwikset, Yale, Baldwin), deadbolt installs, keypad and smart locks, house lockouts.
- https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/residential-locksmith-nashville/

## Service Areas (Middle Tennessee)
Nashville, Brentwood, Franklin, Antioch, Donelson, Hermitage, Belle Meade, Green Hills, Berry Hill, Nolensville, Mount Juliet, Hendersonville and Smyrna. All area coverage is described on one page:
- https://armstronglocksmithinc.com/service-areas/
